reason: Visit-time memberContract is now persisted in full (native names plus identity claims) from the complete validated person; the registry stream reads those pinned names and does not recompute keys from a lossy projection. Same/different constraints still drive accepted clustering, duplicate-id and source-chapter gates are unchanged, posting fingerprints are finalized only after every cluster is yielded, and a missing member cannot write a manifest. Unpublished ${out}.members is rejected before validation, close() flushes accepted rows, and only a published generation deletes the spool. Limits, pair-graph policy, and validators are not weakened.
